body.statement: Suppose the rank is two, the factor rows are in general position, and the rank-two observed-outcome-overlap algorithm converges to one super-cohort whose observed-outcome union is \([T]\). Then \(\operatorname{col}(\Gamma)=\ker A(P)\).

source.locator: Theorem 1 in Section 3.1 (Factor Identification Given Cohort-Specific Factors), arXiv version 3
source.verbatim_statement: Suppose the factor vectors are in general position and the O3 Algorithm converges to a single super cohort for whom all outcomes are observed. Then Gamma’s column space is exactly the null space of the population APM A.
